	External calls:
	- msg.sender.send(msg.value - value) (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#141)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- rounds[roundIndex].ticketsCount += ticketsCount (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#146)
	- buyersLength = rounds[roundIndex].buyers.length ++ (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#149)
	- rounds[roundIndex].buyers[buyersLength] = msg.sender (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#150)
	- rounds[roundIndex].ticketsCountByBuyer[msg.sender] += ticketsCount (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#153)
	- rounds[roundIndex].ticketsCount += ticketsCount (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#154)
	- rounds[roundIndex].pot += value (../sb/etherpot_lotto.sol#157)
